prompt: Calcule toute l’attention causale à une tête : scores, masque, softmax et valeurs.
solution:
import numpy as np
def attention(q,k,v):
    q,k,v=map(np.asarray,(q,k,v))
    z=q@k.T/q.shape[-1]**.5
    z=np.where(np.tril(np.ones(z.shape,dtype=bool)),z,-1e9)
    e=np.exp(z-z.max(-1,keepdims=True))
    return e/e.sum(-1,keepdims=True)@v
check:
q=np.eye(2); a=attention(q,q,[[2.,3.],[9.,8.]]); b=attention(q,q,[[2.,3.],[99.,88.]]); np.testing.assert_allclose(a[0],[2,3]); np.testing.assert_allclose(a[0],b[0]); assert a.shape==(2,2)
np.testing.assert_allclose(attention([[0],[0],[0]],[[0],[0],[0]],[[2.],[4.],[9.]]),[[2.],[3.],[5.]],atol=1e-8)
np.testing.assert_allclose(a[1],[(2+9*np.exp(1/np.sqrt(2)))/(1+np.exp(1/np.sqrt(2))),(3+8*np.exp(1/np.sqrt(2)))/(1+np.exp(1/np.sqrt(2)))])
